title: [MVP 2.0] Redo action
body:
## Description
Add a Redo action to complement Undo. Users should be able to redo the last undone action.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Redo button in UI (e.g. header menu or play screen)
- [ ] Redo keyboard shortcut (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z)
- [ ] Redo disabled when nothing to redo
- [ ] Redo clears redo stack when user performs a new action (standard undo/redo behavior)

## Context
Roadmap item. UndoManager already exists; extend to support redo history.

title: [MVP 2.0] Edge-piece filtering
body:
## Description
Add filtering to show only edge pieces (or corners, edges, center) to help users focus on assembling the puzzle.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Filter/toggle to show only edge pieces on board
- [ ] Option to show only corner pieces
- [ ] Option to show only center pieces
- [ ] Clear visual feedback when filter is active
- [ ] Works with Piece Drawer (tray) filtering

## Context
Roadmap item. PieceTray already has All/Edges/Center/Corners filter; extend to board view or integrate with piece visibility.

title: [MVP 2.0] Zoom and pan for large puzzles
body:
## Description
Add zoom and pan controls for puzzles with many pieces (e.g. 6×6, 7×5) so users can navigate the board when it exceeds the viewport.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pinch-to-zoom on mobile
- [ ] Scroll wheel zoom on desktop
- [ ] Pan/drag to move around the board when zoomed
- [ ] Zoom limits (min/max) to prevent extreme zoom
- [ ] Optional: zoom controls (buttons or slider) for accessibility

## Context
Roadmap item. Important for 35+ piece puzzles on small screens.

title: [MVP 2.0] Import puzzle from URL
body:
## Description
Allow users to create a puzzle from an image URL instead of only uploading from device or camera.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Input field for image URL on New Game / Setup screen
- [ ] Fetch and validate image (CORS, format)
- [ ] Error handling for invalid URLs or failed fetches
- [ ] Same grid size selection as other image sources

## Context
Roadmap item. Enables sharing puzzle links and using external images.

title: [MVP 2.0] PWA / offline support
body:
## Description
Make Phuzzle installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline support and caching.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Web app manifest (manifest.json) with icons and metadata
- [ ] Service worker for offline caching of core assets
- [ ] Graceful degradation when offline (e.g. show cached puzzles, message for network features)
- [ ] App installable on iOS and Android

## Context
Roadmap item. Improves mobile experience and reliability.

title: [MVP 2.0] Custom grid sizes (e.g. 7×5, 8×6)
body:
## Description
Allow users to choose custom grid sizes beyond the current 3×3 to 6×6 presets, e.g. 7×5, 8×6, or arbitrary rows × cols.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Custom grid size selector on Setup screen
- [ ] Min/max constraints (e.g. 3–10 rows/cols)
- [ ] Piece sizing scales appropriately.
- [ ] Validation for very large grids (performance consideration)

## Context
Users have requested 35-piece (5×7) puzzles; extend to more flexible grid options.

title: [MVP 2.0] Puzzle difficulty presets (Easy/Medium/Hard)
body:
## Description
Add named difficulty presets (Easy, Medium, Hard) that map to grid size and optionally time mode, so users can quickly start a game at their preferred challenge level.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Easy/Medium/Hard buttons or selector on menu or New Game screen
- [ ] Each preset maps to sensible grid size (e.g. Easy=3×3, Medium=4×4, Hard=5×5)
- [ ] Optional: preset includes time mode (e.g. Hard = countdown)
- [ ] Clear labeling of what each preset means

## Context
Improves onboarding and quick-start experience.

title: [MVP 2.0] Save/load puzzle state to cloud (Supabase)
body:
## Description
Persist puzzle progress to Supabase so users can resume on another device or after clearing browser data.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Save puzzle state to Supabase when user is signed in
- [ ] Load puzzle state on app start if user has active game
- [ ] Sync conflict handling (e.g. most recent wins)
- [ ] Fallback to localStorage when offline or not signed in

## Context
Supabase already used for stats, leaderboards, auth. Extends persistence.

title: [MVP 2.0] Accessibility: screen reader support
body:
## Description
Improve accessibility for screen reader users by adding proper ARIA labels, roles, and live regions for puzzle state and interactions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ARIA labels on interactive elements (buttons, pieces, tray)
- [ ] Live region announcements for piece placement, snap, completion
- [ ] Keyboard navigation for piece selection and placement
- [ ] Focus management for modals and overlays

## Context
Aligns with accessibility best practices and inclusivity.

title: [MVP 2.0] Performance: virtualize piece rendering for large puzzles
body:
## Description
Optimize rendering for puzzles with 50+ pieces by only drawing pieces visible in the viewport (or virtualized list for tray).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Canvas: only draw pieces that intersect or are near the visible area
- [ ] Tray: virtualize list if many pieces in drawer
- [ ] No visible regressions or flicker
- [ ] Measurable improvement on large grids (e.g. 8×8)

## Context
Enables larger puzzles without performance degradation.
